goal: Iske baad aap pointer parameters wala function likh sakte hain, usay & ke saath call kar sakte hain, pointers ke zariye caller ke variables badal sakte hain, ek se zyada results wapas de sakte hain, aur pointer ko nullptr ke liye check kar sakte hain.
warmup: Aap chahte hain ke aap ka dost aap ke ghar ki deewar ka rang kare. Aap deewar usay uske ghar nahi bhej sakte. Is ke bajaye aap usay apne ghar ka ADDRESS dete hain. Woh wahan jata hai aur aap ki apni deewar paint karta hai. Pass by address bhi yehi hai. Caller variable ya uski copy nahi bhejta, woh yeh bhejta hai ke variable kahan rehta hai. Function wahan jata hai aur asli cheez badal deta hai.
definition: Pass by address (jisay pass by pointer bhi kehte hain) mein caller kisi variable ka address bhejta hai, jo &x likha jata hai. Function usay pointer parameter mein receive karta hai, jaise int *p. Pointer ko dereference (*p) kar ke function caller ka variable parh aur badal sakta hai. Pointer khud address ki copy hai, lekin woh asli variable par point karta hai, is liye function ke wapas aane ke baad bhi tabdeeliyan barqarar rehti hain.
howItWorks: Traces chalayein aur call stack dekhein. Jab main doubleIt(&x) call karta hai, function apna pointer box n banata hai aur usmein x ka address store kar deta hai. Call stack n ko 0x1000 -> points to x ki tarah dikhata hai. Function ke andar *n = *n * 2 us address ke peeche jata hai aur main ka x badal deta hai. Jab function khatam hota hai, n gayab ho jata hai, lekin x nayi value rakhta hai. Do symbols yaad rakhein: CALL par &x likhte hain (address), function ke andar *p likhte hain (address par value). Baqi do tareeqon se compare karein. By value: f(x) aur function copy par kaam karta hai. By reference: f(x) aur header mein int &x, aur x usi box ka doosra naam hai. By address: f(&x) aur header mein int *p, aur andar *p use hota hai. Reference aur address dono asli ko badalte hain. Farq symbols ka hai, aur is baat ka ke address null ho sakta hai, is liye pehle check karein: if (p != nullptr). Pass by address se ek function kai results bhi wapas de sakta hai, kyunke aap har result ke liye ek address pass karte hain (jaise calc aur divide mein). Aakhir mein, ek aam bug yeh hai ke *p ki jagah p badal diya jaye. p = p + 1 sirf local pointer ko hilata hai aur caller ka variable nahi badalta.
